newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Acer raises US$160 mln in GDRs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Acer raises US$160 mln in GDRs.

text.p: Taiwan computer giant Acer Inc said on Wednesday it has raised US$160 million in funds for overseas expansion through an issue of global depositary receipts.
Acer said it completed pricing for the GDRs in Hong Kong on Tuesday.
"The total amount of funds raised was higher than the originally expected US$102 million," a company spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone.
Acer used 50 million common shares for the 10 million units of GDR issue, with each unit comprising five shares.
Each unit of Acer GDRs was priced at US$16.06, which is equivalent to T$89.75 per share or a discount of 8.4 percent compared with Acer's Tuesday closing price of T$98, the company spokeswoman said.
Acer said that funds raised from the GDR issue would be used for the company's overseas expansion in the Philippines, Mexico and the United States.
